s: The price of petrol and diesel per litre can be broken down into roughly six parts. As mentioned, the price of crude oil is an important factor. Oil is sold in US dollars, so the comparative strength of the pound also feeds into the price you pay. The cost of making fuel more eco-friendly is also a factor. This is due to the cost of producing biofuel, plus its potential impact on fuel efficiency. When you buy petrol or diesel at the pump, you’re taxed twice.
